evidence_policy: Counts are conservative evidence counts. Manual parameter count is not runtime support. OS-observed count is a confirmed lower bound from reversible register mappings, not an exhaustive OS field sweep. GUI and Q-Link counts reflect V3 source assignments, not physical activation. Q-Link end-to-end count requires trace from a physical Q-Link through internal state to DSP register writes. Per-effect audio delta is null where V2 public sources do not attribute its aggregate result to a specific control/effect. Manual-entry count gaps are not an exact one-to-one unsupported-control list because compound rows are not fully reconciled.
published_v2_audio_change_aggregate: 10 of 16 mapped controls showed nonzero output delta; per-control attribution unavailable in public summary.

totals.audio_count_basis: V2 published aggregate 10/16 plus V3 PITCH SHIFT QUALITY nonzero output difference.
